planets.name: HD 221416 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 221416 with a 14.3-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: HD 221416 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 221416. Its orbit and size follow Huber et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname HUBER_ET_AL__2019): disc_year 2019, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 14.28117312608, pl_radj 0.836, pl_bmassj 0.19

quotes.title: HD 221416 b
quotes.card: HD 221416 b is a confirmed hot-Saturn-type exoplanet 312 light years away from earth and orbiting the late subgiant K-type star, HD 221416.
quotes.introduction: It is part of a small but growing number of discovered exoplanets orbiting evolved stars.
